spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m0p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Cranes, Cap
VARIABLES load, ver, crashed, snap

vars == <<load, ver, crashed, snap>>
NoSnap == [held |-> FALSE, sv |-> 0]

Init ==
  /\ load = 0
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ snap = [c \in Cranes |-> NoSnap]

Read(c) ==
  /\ c \notin crashed
  /\ snap[c].held = FALSE
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = [held |-> TRUE, sv |-> ver]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, crashed>>

Commit(c) ==
  /\ c \notin crashed
  /\ snap[c].held = TRUE
  /\ snap[c].sv = ver
  /\ load < Cap
  /\ load' = load + 1
  /\ ver' = (ver + 1) % 4
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = NoSnap]
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Retry(c) ==
  /\ c \notin crashed
  /\ snap[c].held = TRUE
  /\ snap[c].sv # ver
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = NoSnap]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, crashed>>

Pull ==
  /\ load > 0
  /\ load' = load - 1
  /\ ver' = (ver + 1) % 4
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, snap>>

Crash(c) ==
  /\ c \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) < Cardinality(Cranes) - 1
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = NoSnap]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Cranes : Read(c) \/ Commit(c) \/ Retry(c) \/ Crash(c)
  \/ Pull

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
BoundedYard == load <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Cranes = {c1, c2, c3} Cap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BoundedYard
nl:
A container-ship crane yard has a single ground buffer that can hold at most Cap containers at once. Three straddle cranes race to deposit containers into the buffer, but they coordinate through an optimistic-locking discipline rather than a hard lock. A crane first reads the buffer's current load together with a version stamp, then later tries to commit its deposit; the commit only lands if the version stamp has not moved since the read, otherwise the crane must discard its stale read and try again. A ground tractor occasionally pulls one container back out, which also bumps the version. Any crane may crash silently at any moment, abandoning whatever read it was holding, and after that it never acts again. Because a commit re-checks that the buffer still has room, the yard buffer must never hold more than Cap containers.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the buffer occupancy never exceeds the fixed capacity Cap.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m4p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Tickets, QCap
VARIABLES loc

vars == <<loc>>
Count(a) == Cardinality({t \in Tickets : loc[t] = a})

Init == loc = [t \in Tickets |-> "hall"]

Enqueue(t) ==
  /\ loc[t] = "hall"
  /\ Count("queue") < QCap
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = "queue"]

Board(t) ==
  /\ loc[t] = "queue"
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = "cabin"]

Deliver(t) ==
  /\ loc[t] = "cabin"
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = "drop"]

Recall(t) ==
  /\ loc[t] = "drop"
  /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![t] = "hall"]

Next == \E t \in Tickets : Enqueue(t) \/ Board(t) \/ Deliver(t) \/ Recall(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
TicketsConserved ==
  Count("hall") + Count("queue") + Count("cabin") + Count("drop") = Cardinality(Tickets)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Tickets = {k1, k2, k3, k4} QCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TicketsConserved
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper tracks a fixed set of hall-call tickets that circulate through four holding areas: the hall, a bounded dispatch queue, a cabin, and a completed-drop-off pool. A ticket enters the dispatch queue from the hall only while the queue holds fewer than QCap tickets, which is the backpressure that keeps the dispatcher from being overwhelmed. From the queue a ticket is boarded into a cabin, and from the cabin it is delivered into the drop-off pool. Because riders press the same floor button again later, a delivered ticket eventually returns to the hall. The dispatcher may board tickets out of order, so the queue is treated as an unordered bag rather than a strict line. Tickets are neither created nor destroyed during operation; each of the fixed tickets is always sitting in exactly one of the four areas. The bank starts with every ticket waiting in the hall.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at every moment the tickets spread across the hall, queue, cabin, and drop-off pool sum to the fixed total the bank started with.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m5p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Supervisors, Quorum, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, proposal, votes, applied

vars == <<epoch, proposal, votes, applied>>
NoApply == [mode |-> "none", count |-> 0]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ proposal = FALSE
  /\ votes = {}
  /\ applied = NoApply

Propose ==
  /\ proposal = FALSE
  /\ proposal' = TRUE
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, applied>>

Vote(s) ==
  /\ proposal = TRUE
  /\ s \notin votes
  /\ votes' = votes \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, proposal, applied>>

Commit ==
  /\ proposal = TRUE
  /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
  /\ applied' = [mode |-> "quorum", count |-> Cardinality(votes)]
  /\ proposal' = FALSE
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED epoch

AdminApply ==
  /\ applied' = [mode |-> "admin", count |-> 0]
  /\ proposal' = FALSE
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED epoch

AdvanceEpoch ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ proposal' = FALSE
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED applied

Next == Propose \/ Commit \/ AdminApply \/ AdvanceEpoch \/ \E s \in Supervisors : Vote(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
AuthorizedMoves == applied.mode = "quorum" => applied.count >= Quorum
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Supervisors = {s1, s2, s3} Quorum = 2 MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AuthorizedMoves
nl:
A container-ship crane yard commits each gantry move only after a quorum of shift supervisors votes to approve it in the current planning epoch. A move is first proposed, then supervisors cast votes for the standing proposal; once the number of votes reaches Quorum the move is committed and recorded as quorum-approved. When the yard is reconfigured the planning epoch advances, which cancels any half-collected votes so that supervisors from a stale round cannot push a move through. A privileged yard admin holds an override: the admin may commit a move directly, and such a move is recorded as admin-issued rather than quorum-approved. The recorder keeps, for the last committed move, both how it was authorized and how many supervisor votes backed it. Every committed move must therefore be either an admin override or a genuinely quorum-backed move that gathered at least Quorum votes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any committed move recorded as quorum-approved was backed by at least Quorum supervisor votes.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m0p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Engines, MaxVer
VARIABLES ver, cached, ready, winner, winnerVer

vars == <<ver, cached, ready, winner, winnerVer>>

Init ==
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ cached = [e \in Engines |-> 0]
  /\ ready = [e \in Engines |-> FALSE]
  /\ winner = "none"
  /\ winnerVer = 0

Refresh(e) ==
  /\ cached' = [cached EXCEPT ![e] = ver]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, ready, winner, winnerVer>>

Compute(e) ==
  /\ cached[e] = ver
  /\ ready' = [ready EXCEPT ![e] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, cached, winner, winnerVer>>

Write(e) ==
  /\ ready[e] = TRUE
  /\ cached[e] = ver
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ winner' = e
  /\ winnerVer' = ver
  /\ ready' = [ready EXCEPT ![e] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED cached

OrderFlow ==
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cached, ready, winner, winnerVer>>

Next == \E e \in Engines : Refresh(e) \/ Compute(e) \/ Write(e) \/ OrderFlow

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoStaleWriter == winner = "none" \/ cached[winner] >= winnerVer
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Engines = {A, B} MaxVer = 4
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleWriter
nl:
A stock exchange runs its opening auction with two independent matching engines, A and B, that share one price register plus a version stamp. Each engine keeps a private cached copy of the version; it refreshes that cache to the live version, then computes a candidate opening price, and only afterwards attempts to write. A write commits only when the engine's cached version still equals the live version, and a successful write bumps the version so the other engine's cache becomes stale. Ordinary order-flow updates may also bump the version at any time, invalidating both caches. Because the two engines share the same register, an engine whose cache has fallen behind must refresh before it can win the write. The register records which engine last wrote and the version it stamped. The winning engine's cache is therefore never older than the version it managed to stamp.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whichever engine last wrote the register holds a cached version at least as new as the version stamp it wrote.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m1p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Nodes
VARIABLES holder, posting, dead

vars == <<holder, posting, dead>>
Live == Nodes \ dead

Init ==
  /\ holder = CHOOSE n \in Nodes : TRUE
  /\ posting = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
  /\ dead = {}

Post ==
  /\ posting[holder] = FALSE
  /\ posting' = [posting EXCEPT ![holder] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, dead>>

Record ==
  /\ posting[holder] = TRUE
  /\ posting' = [posting EXCEPT ![holder] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, dead>>

Pass ==
  /\ posting[holder] = FALSE
  /\ \E m \in Live : holder' = m
  /\ UNCHANGED <<posting, dead>>

Crash(n) ==
  /\ n # holder
  /\ n \notin dead
  /\ dead' = dead \cup {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, posting>>

Next == Post \/ Record \/ Pass \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
ExclusivePoster == \A n \in Nodes : posting[n] => n = holder
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Nodes = {n0, n1, n2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ExclusivePoster
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction is computed by a ring of quote nodes that pass a single access token around; only the node currently holding the token is permitted to post an opening quote. When the holder is done it passes the token to the next live node in ring order, skipping any node that has crashed. A node other than the current holder may crash silently and then never participates again, but the holder itself never vanishes while holding the token. A node posts by raising its posting flag, and lowers the flag when the quote is recorded. Because the token is a single value, exactly one node holds it at a time, and a node without the token must never be seen posting. The auction begins with node n0 holding the token and no node posting.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any node with its posting flag raised is the current token holder.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m9p5t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Operators, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, manifest, sealer, buffer

vars == <<epoch, manifest, sealer, buffer>>

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ manifest = "open"
  /\ sealer = "none"
  /\ buffer = {}

Submit(op) ==
  /\ buffer' = buffer \cup {[op |-> op, ep |-> epoch]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, manifest, sealer>>

Reconfig ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<manifest, sealer, buffer>>

ApplySeal ==
  /\ manifest = "open"
  /\ \E c \in buffer :
       /\ c.ep = epoch
       /\ manifest' = "sealed"
       /\ sealer' = c.op
       /\ buffer' = buffer \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Discard ==
  /\ \E c \in buffer :
       /\ c.ep < epoch
       /\ buffer' = buffer \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, manifest, sealer>>

Next == Reconfig \/ ApplySeal \/ Discard \/ \E op \in Operators : Submit(op)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
OneShotManifest == (manifest = "sealed") <=> (sealer # "none")
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Operators = {op1, op2} MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneShotManifest
nl:
A container-ship crane yard eventually performs one irreversible act: sealing the export manifest, after which no further containers may be added. Operators submit seal commands into an unordered command buffer, and each command carries the reconfiguration epoch under which it was issued. The yard periodically reconfigures its berth layout, which advances the epoch; a buffered seal command whose epoch is older than the current epoch is stale and gets discarded rather than applied. The manifest starts open with no recorded sealer. Applying a fresh seal command moves the manifest from open to sealed and records which operator sealed it. Once sealed the manifest can never reopen and its recorded sealer never changes, so the sealed state and the presence of a recorded sealer always agree. Commands may be consumed in any order from the buffer.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the manifest is in the sealed state if and only if a sealing operator has been recorded.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m4p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS TotalRooms, QCap
VARIABLES queue, occupied

vars == <<queue, occupied>>

Init ==
  /\ queue = 0
  /\ occupied = 0

Enqueue ==
  /\ queue < QCap
  /\ queue' = queue + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED occupied

OpenDay ==
  /\ queue > 0
  /\ occupied < TotalRooms
  /\ occupied' = occupied + 1
  /\ queue' = queue - 1

OpenNight ==
  /\ queue > 0
  /\ occupied < TotalRooms
  /\ occupied' = occupied + 1
  /\ queue' = queue - 1

Finish ==
  /\ occupied > 0
  /\ occupied' = occupied - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED queue

Next == Enqueue \/ OpenDay \/ OpenNight \/ Finish

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
RoomsWithinCapacity == occupied <= TotalRooms
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS TotalRooms = 3 QCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RoomsWithinCapacity
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler admits surgeries into a shared pool of operating rooms whose total is TotalRooms. Two independent scheduler instances, day and night, draw from the very same pool of rooms. Incoming surgery requests first land in a bounded admission queue; a request may join the queue only while it holds fewer than QCap entries, which is the backpressure protecting the schedulers. Either instance may pull a queued request and open a room for it, but only when a room is actually free. When a surgery finishes its room is released back to the pool. Because both instances check room availability against the shared occupancy before opening a room, the number of occupied rooms can never exceed the total available. The system starts with an empty queue and every room free.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of simultaneously occupied operating rooms never exceeds TotalRooms.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m8p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Trains
VARIABLES coarse, fine, occ, dead

vars == <<coarse, fine, occ, dead>>
Region == "R"
Blocks == {"b1", "b2"}

Init ==
  /\ coarse = "none"
  /\ fine = [b \in Blocks |-> "none"]
  /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> "none"]
  /\ dead = {}

AcquireCoarse(t) ==
  /\ t \notin dead
  /\ coarse = "none"
  /\ coarse' = t
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, occ, dead>>

AcquireFine(t, b) ==
  /\ t \notin dead
  /\ coarse = t
  /\ fine[b] = "none"
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = t]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, occ, dead>>

Enter(t, b) ==
  /\ t \notin dead
  /\ coarse = t
  /\ fine[b] = t
  /\ occ[b] = "none"
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = t]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, dead>>

Leave(t, b) ==
  /\ occ[b] = t
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, dead>>

DropCoarse(t) ==
  /\ coarse = t
  /\ \A b \in Blocks : fine[b] # t
  /\ coarse' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, occ, dead>>

Crash(t) ==
  /\ t \notin dead
  /\ coarse # t
  /\ Cardinality(dead) < Cardinality(Trains) - 1
  /\ \A b \in Blocks : occ[b] # t /\ fine[b] # t
  /\ dead' = dead \cup {t}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, occ>>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Trains : AcquireCoarse(t) \/ DropCoarse(t) \/ Crash(t)
  \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : AcquireFine(t, b) \/ Enter(t, b) \/ Leave(t, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
OccupantHoldsBothLocks ==
  \A b \in Blocks : occ[b] # "none" => (fine[b] = occ[b] /\ coarse = occ[b])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Trains = {t1, t2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OccupantHoldsBothLocks
nl:
A subway signalling system protects track blocks with a two-level hierarchical lock: a train must first grab the coarse lock for the region a block belongs to, then the fine lock for the specific block, before it may occupy that block. Each region groups several blocks, and the coarse lock serialises trains competing for any block in the region. A train that has acquired both the region's coarse lock and a block's fine lock may enter and occupy that block. A train other than one currently occupying a block may crash silently and stop acting. To leave, a train vacates the block and drops both locks. No train may be occupying a block unless it simultaneously holds that block's fine lock and its region's coarse lock, so a stale or unauthorised train can never be sitting on a block.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every occupied block is occupied by a train that holds both that block's fine lock and its region's coarse lock.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od3m4p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Banks, Slots, QCap
VARIABLES owner, held, queue, dead

vars == <<owner, held, queue, dead>>

Init ==
  /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> "free"]
  /\ held = [b \in Banks |-> {}]
  /\ queue = 0
  /\ dead = {}

Lodge(b) ==
  /\ b \notin dead
  /\ queue < QCap
  /\ queue' = queue + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, dead>>

Grant(b, s) ==
  /\ b \notin dead
  /\ queue > 0
  /\ owner[s] = "free"
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = b]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![b] = held[b] \cup {s}]
  /\ queue' = queue - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED dead

Release(b, s) ==
  /\ s \in held[b]
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![b] = held[b] \ {s}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, dead>>

Crash(b) ==
  /\ b \notin dead
  /\ held[b] = {}
  /\ Cardinality(dead) < Cardinality(Banks) - 1
  /\ dead' = dead \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, queue>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Lodge(b) \/ Crash(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks, s \in Slots : Grant(b, s) \/ Release(b, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
SlotViewsCoherent ==
  \A b \in Banks, s \in Slots : (owner[s] = b) <=> (s \in held[b])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Banks = {bk1, bk2} Slots = {s1, s2} QCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SlotViewsCoherent
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch assigns each settlement slot to at most one member bank at a time. Assignment requests flow through a bounded work queue with backpressure: a bank may lodge a claim only while the queue holds fewer than QCap pending claims. A queued claim is granted by binding a currently free slot to the claiming bank, which both marks the slot's owner and adds the slot to that bank's held-set. When settlement completes the bank releases the slot, clearing the owner and removing it from its held-set. A member bank may crash silently and stop lodging or releasing, but the two bookkeeping views must stay consistent: a slot lists a bank as owner exactly when that bank's held-set contains the slot. The batch starts with all slots free and an empty queue.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every bank and slot, the slot names that bank as owner if and only if the bank's held-set contains that slot.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m1p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Patrons, Copies, Terminals
VARIABLES resv, bag, token

vars == <<resv, bag, token>>

Init ==
  /\ resv = [c \in Copies |-> "none"]
  /\ bag = [p \in Patrons |-> {}]
  /\ token = "T1"

Reserve(p, c) ==
  /\ resv[c] = "none"
  /\ resv' = [resv EXCEPT ![c] = p]
  /\ bag' = [bag EXCEPT ![p] = bag[p] \cup {c}]
  /\ UNCHANGED token

Cancel(p, c) ==
  /\ c \in bag[p]
  /\ resv' = [resv EXCEPT ![c] = "none"]
  /\ bag' = [bag EXCEPT ![p] = bag[p] \ {c}]
  /\ UNCHANGED token

PassToken ==
  /\ \E u \in Terminals : token' = u
  /\ UNCHANGED <<resv, bag>>

Sync ==
  /\ UNCHANGED <<resv, bag, token>>

Next ==
  \/ PassToken
  \/ Sync
  \/ \E p \in Patrons, c \in Copies : Reserve(p, c) \/ Cancel(p, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
ReservationCoherent ==
  \A p \in Patrons, c \in Copies : (resv[c] = p) <=> (c \in bag[p])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Patrons = {p1, p2} Copies = {c1, c2} Terminals = {T1, T2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ReservationCoherent
nl:
A library book-reservation system lets patrons reserve copies, but each copy may be reserved by at most one patron at a time. Two branch terminals share the very same catalog of copies, and they coordinate through a token ring: only the terminal currently holding the reservation token may bind or free a copy, guaranteeing the shared pool is touched by one terminal at a time. When a copy is reserved, the copy records its reserving patron and the patron's reservation-set gains that copy. Cancelling a reservation clears the copy's record and drops it from the patron's set. The token is passed between the two terminals so each gets exclusive turns over the shared catalog. The two views of a reservation must always agree: a copy names a patron exactly when that patron's set holds the copy. The system starts with all copies unreserved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every patron and copy, the copy records that patron as holder if and only if the patron's reservation-set contains the copy.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m9p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxVer
VARIABLES version, record, base, committed

vars == <<version, record, base, committed>>

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ record = {}
  /\ base = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
  /\ committed = {}

Read(c) ==
  /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![c] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, record, committed>>

Commit(c) ==
  /\ base[c] = version
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ record' = record \cup {c}
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {c}
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED base

Retry(c) ==
  /\ base[c] # version
  /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![c] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, record, committed>>

Next == \E c \in Controllers : Read(c) \/ Commit(c) \/ Retry(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
ContributionsPreserved == \A c \in Controllers : c \in committed => c \in record
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Controllers = {c1, c2, c3} MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ContributionsPreserved
nl:
An elevator bank keeps a shared configuration record that several controllers update, and no controller's committed update may be silently lost. The record is a merged set of controller contributions guarded by a version number. Under epoch-numbered reconfiguration, each controller first reads the current version as its base, then attempts to commit its contribution. A commit succeeds only if the controller's base still equals the live version, at which point the controller's contribution is merged into the record and the version advances. A controller whose base has fallen behind is slow but not failed: it simply rereads and retries rather than crashing. Because a successful commit never drops previously merged contributions, every controller that has committed remains represented in the record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every controller whose update has committed still has its contribution present in the shared record.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m3p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxTerm
VARIABLES leader, term, roster, acked

vars == <<leader, term, roster, acked>>

Init ==
  /\ leader = "m0"
  /\ term = 0
  /\ roster = {}
  /\ acked = {}

Apply(n, w) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ w \notin roster
  /\ roster' = roster \cup {w}
  /\ acked' = acked \cup {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term>>

Failover(n) ==
  /\ n # leader
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<roster, acked>>

Heartbeat ==
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, roster, acked>>

Next ==
  \/ Heartbeat
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Failover(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, w \in {"w1", "w2"} : Apply(n, w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
AckedWritesRetained == \A w \in acked : w \in roster
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Nodes = {m0, m1, m2} MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AckedWritesRetained
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker keeps a shared roster of confirmed players that must never lose an acknowledged write. One matchmaker node is elected leader and owns the roster; the others are followers. Only the current leader applies a write, and doing so both stamps the write into the roster and marks it acknowledged. If the leader is deemed slow but not failed, the cluster fails over by electing a new leader, but the roster carries over intact. A write is applied under a term number; on failover the term advances, and only the leader of the current term may apply. Because leadership handover preserves the roster, any write that was acknowledged stays in the roster across leader changes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every write that has been acknowledged remains present in the shared roster.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m6p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Dispatchers, Shafts, Span, MaxClock
VARIABLES clock, lease, expiry, running

vars == <<clock, lease, expiry, running>>

Init ==
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ lease = [s \in Shafts |-> "none"]
  /\ expiry = [s \in Shafts |-> 0]
  /\ running = [s \in Shafts |-> "none"]

Acquire(d, s) ==
  /\ lease[s] = "none"
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![s] = d]
  /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = clock + Span]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, running>>

Run(d, s) ==
  /\ lease[s] = d
  /\ expiry[s] > clock
  /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![s] = d]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, expiry>>

Stop(s) ==
  /\ running[s] # "none"
  /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, expiry>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxClock
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, expiry, running>>

Reclaim(s) ==
  /\ lease[s] # "none"
  /\ expiry[s] <= clock
  /\ running[s] = "none"
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, running>>

Next ==
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E s \in Shafts : Stop(s) \/ Reclaim(s)
  \/ \E d \in Dispatchers, s \in Shafts : Acquire(d, s) \/ Run(d, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
UserHoldsValidLease ==
  \A s \in Shafts : running[s] # "none" => lease[s] = running[s]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Dispatchers = {d1, d2} Shafts = {sh1, sh2} Span = 2 MaxClock = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT UserHoldsValidLease
nl:
An elevator bank grants each shaft to a dispatcher through a time-limited lease rather than a permanent lock. A dispatcher acquires a shaft's lease only when the shaft is unleased, receiving an expiry time set a fixed span ahead of the current clock. Only a dispatcher whose lease has not yet expired may run cars in that shaft. The clock ticks forward, and when a lease's expiry falls at or before the clock the lease is reclaimed and the shaft becomes free again, so a stale lease-holder loses its authority. The bank's usable shaft capacity changes at runtime as shafts are taken in or out of service. A shaft's lease is only reclaimed once its dispatcher has stopped running it, so any shaft under a running dispatcher is still held by exactly that dispatcher. No dispatcher may be running a shaft it does not currently hold the lease for, which keeps a stale dispatcher from acting.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any shaft being run is run by the very dispatcher that currently holds that shaft's lease.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m2p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Vessels, Berths
VARIABLES owner, booked, pending

vars == <<owner, booked, pending>>
Idle == [ph |-> "idle", v |-> "none", b |-> "none"]

Init ==
  /\ owner = [b \in Berths |-> "free"]
  /\ booked = [v \in Vessels |-> {}]
  /\ pending = Idle

Prepare(v, b) ==
  /\ pending.ph = "idle"
  /\ owner[b] = "free"
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = "prepared"]
  /\ pending' = [ph |-> "prepared", v |-> v, b |-> b]
  /\ UNCHANGED booked

Commit ==
  /\ pending.ph = "prepared"
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![pending.b] = pending.v]
  /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![pending.v] = booked[pending.v] \cup {pending.b}]
  /\ pending' = Idle

Abort ==
  /\ pending.ph = "prepared"
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![pending.b] = "free"]
  /\ pending' = Idle
  /\ UNCHANGED booked

Release(v, b) ==
  /\ owner[b] = v
  /\ b \in booked[v]
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = "free"]
  /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![v] = booked[v] \ {b}]
  /\ UNCHANGED pending

TakeOut(b) ==
  /\ owner[b] = "free"
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = "oos"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, pending>>

Restore(b) ==
  /\ owner[b] = "oos"
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = "free"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ Commit \/ Abort
  \/ \E b \in Berths : TakeOut(b) \/ Restore(b)
  \/ \E v \in Vessels, b \in Berths : Prepare(v, b) \/ Release(v, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
BerthAllocCoherent ==
  \A v \in Vessels, b \in Berths : (owner[b] = v) <=> (b \in booked[v])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Vessels = {v1, v2} Berths = {be1, be2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BerthAllocCoherent
nl:
A container-ship crane yard allocates berth slots to vessels using a two-phase commit so that no berth is ever double-allocated. A coordinator first prepares a booking by tentatively reserving a free berth for a vessel and holding it in a prepared state; it then either commits the booking, finalising the berth to that vessel, or aborts, releasing the berth back to free. Only one booking may be in preparation at a time, and a finalised berth may later be released back to free. The yard's usable berth capacity changes at runtime: a currently free berth may be taken out of service, and an out-of-service berth may be returned to free. A finalised berth records its vessel, and each vessel's booking-set records its berths, and these two records must always agree. The yard starts with all berths free and no booking in flight.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every vessel and berth, the berth is finalised to that vessel if and only if the vessel's booking-set contains the berth.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m5p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Orders, Units, Reviewers, Quorum
VARIABLES alloc, fulfil, cand, votes

vars == <<alloc, fulfil, cand, votes>>
NoCand == [o |-> "none", u |-> "none"]

Init ==
  /\ alloc = [u \in Units |-> "free"]
  /\ fulfil = [o \in Orders |-> {}]
  /\ cand = NoCand
  /\ votes = {}

Propose(o, u) ==
  /\ cand.o = "none"
  /\ alloc[u] = "free"
  /\ cand' = [o |-> o, u |-> u]
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, fulfil>>

Vote(r) ==
  /\ cand.o # "none"
  /\ r \notin votes
  /\ votes' = votes \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, fulfil, cand>>

Confirm ==
  /\ cand.o # "none"
  /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
  /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![cand.u] = cand.o]
  /\ fulfil' = [fulfil EXCEPT ![cand.o] = fulfil[cand.o] \cup {cand.u}]
  /\ cand' = NoCand
  /\ votes' = {}

Release(o, u) ==
  /\ u \in fulfil[o]
  /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![u] = "free"]
  /\ fulfil' = [fulfil EXCEPT ![o] = fulfil[o] \ {u}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cand, votes>>

Expire(u) ==
  /\ alloc[u] = "free"
  /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![u] = "oos"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fulfil, cand, votes>>

Restock(u) ==
  /\ alloc[u] = "oos"
  /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![u] = "free"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fulfil, cand, votes>>

Next ==
  \/ Confirm
  \/ \E r \in Reviewers : Vote(r)
  \/ \E u \in Units : Expire(u) \/ Restock(u)
  \/ \E o \in Orders, u \in Units : Propose(o, u) \/ Release(o, u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
UnitAllocCoherent ==
  \A o \in Orders, u \in Units : (alloc[u] = o) <=> (u \in fulfil[o])
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Orders = {o1, o2} Units = {u1, u2} Reviewers = {r1, r2, r3} Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT UnitAllocCoherent
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker allocates each blood unit to at most one hospital order, deciding every allocation by quorum vote. A pending allocation of a free unit to an order gathers votes from the duty reviewers; once the votes reach Quorum the allocation is confirmed, binding the unit to the order and adding the unit to the order's fulfilment-set. Releasing an allocation clears the unit and drops it from the order's set. The bank's usable inventory changes at runtime as units expire out of service or fresh units are brought into service. The two records of an allocation must always agree: a unit names an order exactly when that order's fulfilment-set holds the unit. The tracker starts with all units free and no votes cast.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for every order and unit, the unit is allocated to that order if and only if the order's fulfilment-set contains the unit.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m2p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Total
VARIABLES zones, transit

vars == <<zones, transit>>
Z == {"intake", "mid", "gate"}
Escrow == IF transit.ph = "prepared" THEN 1 ELSE 0
ZoneSum == zones["intake"] + zones["mid"] + zones["gate"]

Init ==
  /\ zones = [z \in Z |-> IF z = "intake" THEN Total ELSE 0]
  /\ transit = [ph |-> "idle", from |-> "intake", to |-> "intake"]

Prepare ==
  /\ transit.ph = "idle"
  /\ \E a \in Z, b \in Z :
       /\ a # b
       /\ zones[a] > 0
       /\ zones' = [zones EXCEPT ![a] = zones[a] - 1]
       /\ transit' = [ph |-> "prepared", from |-> a, to |-> b]

Commit ==
  /\ transit.ph = "prepared"
  /\ zones' = [zones EXCEPT ![transit.to] = zones[transit.to] + 1]
  /\ transit' = [ph |-> "idle", from |-> transit.from, to |-> transit.to]

Abort ==
  /\ transit.ph = "prepared"
  /\ zones' = [zones EXCEPT ![transit.from] = zones[transit.from] + 1]
  /\ transit' = [ph |-> "idle", from |-> transit.from, to |-> transit.to]

Stall ==
  /\ transit.ph = "prepared"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zones, transit>>

Next == Prepare \/ Commit \/ Abort \/ Stall

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
BagsConserved == ZoneSum + Escrow = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Total = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BagsConserved
nl:
An airport baggage router shuttles a fixed set of bags between three sorter zones using a two-phase commit for each move. A move first prepares by pulling one bag out of a source zone and holding it in transit escrow, then either commits it into the destination zone or aborts it back to the source. Only one move may be in transit at a time. A sorter arm may be slow but not failed: it can stall a prepared move indefinitely, yet the bag it is holding is never lost because it stays counted in escrow. Bags are never created or destroyed; every bag is always either resting in one of the three zones or held in the single in-transit escrow. The router starts with all bags in the intake zone.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the bags across the three zones plus any bag held in transit escrow always sum to the fixed total the router started with.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m9p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Robots, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES epoch, badge, active, dead

vars == <<epoch, badge, active, dead>>

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ badge = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
  /\ active = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]
  /\ dead = {}

Reconfig ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ \A r \in Robots : active[r] = FALSE
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<badge, active, dead>>

Refresh(r) ==
  /\ r \notin dead
  /\ badge' = [badge EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, active, dead>>

Claim(r) ==
  /\ r \notin dead
  /\ badge[r] = epoch
  /\ active[r] = FALSE
  /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, dead>>

StandDown(r) ==
  /\ active[r] = TRUE
  /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, dead>>

Crash(r) ==
  /\ r \notin dead
  /\ active[r] = FALSE
  /\ Cardinality(dead) < Cardinality(Robots) - 1
  /\ dead' = dead \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, active>>

Next == Reconfig \/ \E r \in Robots : Refresh(r) \/ Claim(r) \/ StandDown(r) \/ Crash(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
CurrentEpochActors == \A r \in Robots : active[r] => badge[r] = epoch
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Robots = {r1, r2, r3} MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CurrentEpochActors
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet operates under an epoch-numbered configuration that is periodically reconfigured. Each robot carries an epoch badge and must refresh it to the fleet's current epoch before it may claim a picking zone. When the fleet reconfigures, the epoch advances and every robot's badge becomes stale until refreshed, so a robot carrying an old badge is barred from claiming. A robot may crash silently and stop participating, but a crashed robot is never mid-claim. Claiming a zone marks the robot as active in that zone; the robot later stands down and clears the claim. No robot may be active in a zone unless its badge matches the current epoch, which keeps stale-epoch robots from acting.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every robot currently active in a zone carries an epoch badge equal to the fleet's current epoch.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m5p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Monitors, Quorum
VARIABLES state, trigger, backing, votes

vars == <<state, trigger, backing, votes>>

Init ==
  /\ state = "running"
  /\ trigger = "none"
  /\ backing = 0
  /\ votes = {}

Vote(m) ==
  /\ state = "running"
  /\ m \notin votes
  /\ votes' = votes \cup {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<state, trigger, backing>>

QuorumHalt ==
  /\ state = "running"
  /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
  /\ state' = "halted"
  /\ trigger' = "quorum"
  /\ backing' = Cardinality(votes)
  /\ UNCHANGED votes

AdminHalt ==
  /\ state = "running"
  /\ state' = "halted"
  /\ trigger' = "admin"
  /\ backing' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED votes

Halted ==
  /\ state = "halted"
  /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == QuorumHalt \/ AdminHalt \/ Halted \/ \E m \in Monitors : Vote(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
HaltAuthorized == trigger = "quorum" => backing >= Quorum
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Monitors = {m1, m2, m3} Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT HaltAuthorized
nl:
An elevator bank can trigger an irreversible emergency halt that, once engaged, permanently stops the cars. The halt is normally authorised by a quorum of safety monitors: a halt proposal collects monitor votes, and only when the votes reach Quorum may the halt engage, recorded as quorum-triggered. A privileged building admin holds an override and may engage the halt directly, recorded as admin-triggered. The system begins in the running state with no recorded trigger. Engaging the halt moves it from running to halted exactly once and records the trigger; it can never return to running. A halt recorded as quorum-triggered must have carried at least Quorum monitor votes at the moment it engaged.
SAFETY PROPERTY: if the emergency halt is recorded as quorum-triggered then at least Quorum monitor votes backed it.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m0p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxVer
VARIABLES version, badge, posting, dead

vars == <<version, badge, posting, dead>>

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ badge = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
  /\ posting = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]
  /\ dead = {}

Refresh(c) ==
  /\ c \notin dead
  /\ badge' = [badge EXCEPT ![c] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, posting, dead>>

Post(c) ==
  /\ c \notin dead
  /\ badge[c] = version
  /\ \A k \in Controllers : posting[k] = FALSE
  /\ posting' = [posting EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, badge, dead>>

Finalize(c) ==
  /\ posting[c] = TRUE
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ posting' = [posting EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<badge, dead>>

Churn ==
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ \A k \in Controllers : posting[k] = FALSE
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<badge, posting, dead>>

Crash(c) ==
  /\ c \notin dead
  /\ posting[c] = FALSE
  /\ Cardinality(dead) < Cardinality(Controllers) - 1
  /\ dead' = dead \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, badge, posting>>

Next == Churn \/ \E c \in Controllers : Refresh(c) \/ Post(c) \/ Finalize(c) \/ Crash(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
AssignerIsCurrent == \A c \in Controllers : posting[c] => badge[c] = version
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Controllers = {c1, c2} MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AssignerIsCurrent
nl:
An elevator bank assigns the next car to a floor request through a shared assignment register protected by optimistic locking. A controller first refreshes its badge to the register's current version, then may post an assignment; the post is honoured only if the controller's badge still equals the live version, and a successful post bumps the version. Ordinary request churn also bumps the version, making outstanding badges stale. A controller may crash silently and stop acting once it has cleared any assignment it was making. No controller may be mid-assignment on the register unless its badge equals the register's current version, which stops a stale controller from writing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any controller currently posting an assignment holds a badge equal to the register's live version.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m4p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Patients, PrepCap
VARIABLES stage

vars == <<stage>>
Num(x) == Cardinality({p \in Patients : stage[p] = x})

Init == stage = [p \in Patients |-> "waiting"]

Prep(p) ==
  /\ stage[p] = "waiting"
  /\ Num("prepped") < PrepCap
  /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![p] = "prepped"]

Operate(p) ==
  /\ stage[p] = "prepped"
  /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![p] = "theatre"]

Recover(p) ==
  /\ stage[p] = "theatre"
  /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![p] = "recovery"]

Discharge(p) ==
  /\ stage[p] = "recovery"
  /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![p] = "waiting"]

Next == \E p \in Patients : Prep(p) \/ Operate(p) \/ Recover(p) \/ Discharge(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
PatientsConserved ==
  Num("waiting") + Num("prepped") + Num("theatre") + Num("recovery") = Cardinality(Patients)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Patients = {pa, pb, pc, pd} PrepCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PatientsConserved
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler moves a fixed roster of patients through four stages: waiting, prepped, in-theatre, and recovery. A patient advances from waiting to prepped only while the prepped holding area has room, bounded by PrepCap, which is the backpressure that keeps intake from flooding the theatre pipeline. A prepped patient enters the theatre, and from the theatre moves into recovery. A recovered patient is eventually discharged back to waiting for a follow-up procedure. A scheduling clerk may be slow but not failed, so a patient can linger in any stage, but no patient is ever created or lost. Every patient in the roster always sits in exactly one of the four stages, so the four stage counts always sum to the fixed roster size. The scheduler starts with all patients waiting.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the patients across the waiting, prepped, in-theatre, and recovery stages always sum to the fixed roster size.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m5p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Committee, Instances, Quorum
VARIABLES decided, approvals, recorded, open

vars == <<decided, approvals, recorded, open>>

Init ==
  /\ decided = FALSE
  /\ approvals = {}
  /\ recorded = 0
  /\ open = FALSE

OpenProp(i) ==
  /\ decided = FALSE
  /\ open = FALSE
  /\ open' = TRUE
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<decided, recorded>>

Approve(m) ==
  /\ open = TRUE
  /\ m \notin approvals
  /\ approvals' = approvals \cup {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<decided, recorded, open>>

Seal ==
  /\ open = TRUE
  /\ Cardinality(approvals) >= Quorum
  /\ decided' = TRUE
  /\ recorded' = Cardinality(approvals)
  /\ open' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED approvals

Reset ==
  /\ decided = TRUE
  /\ decided' = FALSE
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ recorded' = 0
  /\ open' = FALSE

Next ==
  \/ Seal \/ Reset
  \/ \E i \in Instances : OpenProp(i)
  \/ \E m \in Committee : Approve(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
DecisionHadQuorum == decided => recorded >= Quorum
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Committee = {g1, g2, g3} Instances = {I1, I2} Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DecisionHadQuorum
nl:
A container-ship crane yard fixes each shared dispatch decision by quorum vote, and two independent planning instances draw on the same committee and the same decision slot. A decision starts undecided; either instance may open a proposal, after which committee members cast approvals into a shared approval-set. Only when the approvals reach Quorum may the decision be sealed as decided, and the count of approvals at that moment is recorded. Because the two instances share one decision slot, only one proposal is open at a time and both instances honour the same quorum rule. Resetting clears a sealed decision back to undecided for the next planning round. Any decision that is currently sealed must have been backed by at least Quorum committee approvals.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever the shared dispatch decision is sealed, at least Quorum committee members approved it.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od3m5p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Officers, Quorum
VARIABLES batch, finaliser, signs, sigcount

vars == <<batch, finaliser, signs, sigcount>>

Init ==
  /\ batch = "open"
  /\ finaliser = "none"
  /\ signs = {}
  /\ sigcount = 0

Sign(o) ==
  /\ batch = "open"
  /\ o \notin signs
  /\ signs' = signs \cup {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<batch, finaliser, sigcount>>

QuorumFinalize ==
  /\ batch = "open"
  /\ Cardinality(signs) >= Quorum
  /\ batch' = "closed"
  /\ finaliser' = "quorum"
  /\ sigcount' = Cardinality(signs)
  /\ UNCHANGED signs

AdminFinalize ==
  /\ batch = "open"
  /\ batch' = "closed"
  /\ finaliser' = "admin"
  /\ sigcount' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED signs

Closed ==
  /\ batch = "closed"
  /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == QuorumFinalize \/ AdminFinalize \/ Closed \/ \E o \in Officers : Sign(o)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
FinalizeAuthorized == finaliser = "quorum" => sigcount >= Quorum
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Officers = {o1, o2, o3} Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FinalizeAuthorized
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch is finalised exactly once, an irreversible act after which no entry may change. Finalisation is normally authorised by a quorum of clearing officers: a finalisation proposal gathers officer signatures, and only when signatures reach Quorum may the batch be finalised, recorded as quorum-finalised with its signature count. A privileged settlement admin holds an override and may finalise the batch directly, recorded as admin-finalised. The batch starts open with no recorded finaliser. Finalising moves the batch from open to closed exactly once and it can never reopen. A batch recorded as quorum-finalised must have carried at least Quorum officer signatures when it closed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: if the batch is recorded as quorum-finalised then at least Quorum clearing officers signed it.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m7p5t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Hubs, MaxGen
VARIABLES gen, state, pairedHub, inbox

vars == <<gen, state, pairedHub, inbox>>

Init ==
  /\ gen = 0
  /\ state = "unpaired"
  /\ pairedHub = "none"
  /\ inbox = {}

Send(h) ==
  /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[h |-> h, g |-> gen]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, state, pairedHub>>

Duplicate ==
  /\ \E c \in inbox : inbox' = inbox \cup {[h |-> c.h, g |-> c.g]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, state, pairedHub>>

ApplyPair ==
  /\ state = "unpaired"
  /\ \E c \in inbox :
       /\ c.g = gen
       /\ gen < MaxGen
       /\ state' = "paired"
       /\ pairedHub' = c.h
       /\ gen' = gen + 1
       /\ inbox' = inbox \ {c}

DropStale ==
  /\ \E c \in inbox : c.g # gen /\ inbox' = inbox \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, state, pairedHub>>

Next == Duplicate \/ ApplyPair \/ DropStale \/ \E h \in Hubs : Send(h)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
PairingOnceConsistent == (state = "paired") <=> (pairedHub # "none")
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Hubs = {h1, h2} MaxGen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT PairingOnceConsistent
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network performs a one-time irreversible pairing: once a hub is paired to a lock, that binding is permanent. Pairing is mediated by a compare-and-swap register that holds the current pairing generation. Commands arrive over an unreliable channel and may be reordered, so each pairing command carries the generation it expects. A pairing command takes effect only if its expected generation matches the register's live generation; otherwise it is a stale duplicate and is dropped. When a matching command lands, the network moves from unpaired to paired, records the paired hub, and advances the generation so no further reordered command can pair again. The paired state and the presence of a recorded hub always agree, so a reordered duplicate can never create a second pairing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the network is in the paired state if and only if a paired hub has been recorded.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m7p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Riders, MaxLoad
VARIABLES count, ver, snap

vars == <<count, ver, snap>>
NoSnap == [held |-> FALSE, sv |-> 0]

Init ==
  /\ count = 0
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ snap = [r \in Riders |-> NoSnap]

ReadReg(r) ==
  /\ snap[r].held = FALSE
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = [held |-> TRUE, sv |-> ver]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<count, ver>>

Board(r) ==
  /\ snap[r].held = TRUE
  /\ snap[r].sv = ver
  /\ count < MaxLoad
  /\ count' = count + 1
  /\ ver' = (ver + 1) % 3
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = NoSnap]

Retry(r) ==
  /\ snap[r].held = TRUE
  /\ snap[r].sv # ver
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = NoSnap]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<count, ver>>

Leave ==
  /\ count > 0
  /\ count' = count - 1
  /\ ver' = (ver + 1) % 3
  /\ UNCHANGED snap

AdminBump ==
  /\ count < MaxLoad
  /\ count' = count + 1
  /\ ver' = (ver + 1) % 3
  /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next == Leave \/ AdminBump \/ \E r \in Riders : ReadReg(r) \/ Board(r) \/ Retry(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
CabinWithinLimit == count <= MaxLoad
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Riders = {r1, r2} MaxLoad = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CabinWithinLimit
nl:
An elevator bank meters the load of a single cabin through a compare-and-swap register that guards the current occupant count against a limit MaxLoad. A rider boarding first reads the count, then attempts a compare-and-swap: the board succeeds only if the count has not changed since the read and is still below MaxLoad, otherwise the rider rereads and tries again. A rider leaving decrements the count, which also invalidates outstanding reads. A privileged building admin may bump a rider on directly, but the admin still respects the limit and never pushes the cabin over MaxLoad. Every board path re-checks room against the limit, so the cabin occupant count never exceeds MaxLoad. The cabin starts empty.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the cabin occupant count never exceeds the load limit MaxLoad.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m2p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Crews, MaxVer
VARIABLES version, record, committed, prep, capacity

vars == <<version, record, committed, prep, capacity>>
NoPrep == [active |-> FALSE, crew |-> "none", base |-> 0]

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ record = {}
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ prep = NoPrep
  /\ capacity = 2

Prepare(cw) ==
  /\ prep.active = FALSE
  /\ prep' = [active |-> TRUE, crew |-> cw, base |-> version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, record, committed, capacity>>

Commit ==
  /\ prep.active = TRUE
  /\ prep.base = version
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ record' = record \cup {prep.crew}
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {prep.crew}
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ prep' = NoPrep
  /\ UNCHANGED capacity

Abort ==
  /\ prep.active = TRUE
  /\ prep' = NoPrep
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, record, committed, capacity>>

Scale ==
  /\ \E n \in 1..3 : capacity' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, record, committed, prep>>

Next == Commit \/ Abort \/ Scale \/ \E cw \in Crews : Prepare(cw)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
MergedUpdatesRetained == \A cw \in Crews : cw \in committed => cw \in record
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Crews = {cw1, cw2} MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MergedUpdatesRetained
nl:
An elevator bank maintains a shared service-schedule record that maintenance crews update through a two-phase commit, and no committed update may be lost. A crew's update is guarded by a version stamp; the crew prepares by reading the current version as its base, then the coordinator either commits, merging the update into the record and advancing the version, or aborts, leaving the record untouched. A commit is allowed only when the preparing crew's base still matches the live version. The bank's serviceable-shaft capacity changes at runtime, but that never rewrites the schedule record. Only one update may be in preparation at a time. Because a commit merges without discarding earlier merged updates, every update that has committed stays present in the schedule record.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every maintenance update that has committed remains present in the shared schedule record.
